about: The topics an ACQ customer answers in the open call. The caller text is copied from the P-five open-call topics (a paraphrase of each question, never a value). Everything the writer model is told about the call apart from the customer's own fact sheet.

variants.own: what this person says when they answer for themselves, from what they know; when they do not know, they say so in their own words
variants.again: what they say when the caller asks the same thing a second time in other words: the same content, worded differently
variants.defer: what they say when they do not answer for themselves and leave it to the lender, for example 'whatever is in your records': a few words that carry no fact, no figure and no name of anything

open_call.caller: The caller mentions the loan you took recently and asks: did you take anything else along with the loan, and if so, what and for how much?
The caller asks: in your own words, what is that thing you took with the loan?
The caller asks: how much did you pay for it?
The caller asks: where did the money for it come from, and how was it paid?
The caller asks: was it one payment, or do you pay again and again?
The caller asks: was it needed to get the loan, or was it your own choice?
The caller asks: what were you told about where, or from whom, you could take it?
The caller asks: what does it give you, and up to what amount?
The caller asks: how long does it run?
The caller asks: can it be cancelled, and until when?
The caller asks: if you wanted this money back, what would happen?
The caller asks: when you took the loan, what did you say yes to, and how did you say yes?
